answer: One concrete defense: a memory-hard liveness proof every identity must compute simultaneously each epoch, each demanding gigabytes of RAM held at once. A single ferrous server can host only so many masks before its memory saturates, so a sybil fleet cannot echo one cheap backend across a thousand identities. Every fake needs its own dedicated RAM, like a separate ivory tower it must furnish, so faking N agents costs N genuine machines, not one, turning scale into linear hardware spend.
